panel.title: All modules (ENET cable)
panel.hint: Deep scan over the yellow ENET cable — every module's fault memory (airbag, ABS, iDrive, gearbox…), not just the engine. Plug the cable into the car's OBD port and the laptop's USB-Ethernet adapter, ignition ON, give the link ~30s to settle, then scan. BMW F-Series (≈2011–2018); read-only unless you clear.
panel.scanBusy: Walking every module through the gateway… (30–60s, absent modules time out quietly)
